programs.title: Shoot to Kill: The Hunt for the London Bombers
programs.desc: On July 22, 2005, the London police made a mistake.After many days of searching for the suicide bomber responsible for the attack on July 7 and the failed attack on July 21, innocent Jean Charles de Menezes was killed by police bullets.The action was supposed to be the culmination of a large-scale campaign, but it turned out to be a dramatic mistake and shocked public opinion.After almost 20 years, one of the senior policemen appears on the screen.The events of the fateful day are also described by the then Prime Minister Tony Blair, the victim's friend, Gesio de Avila, and witnesses of the event.
